pages.text: [#](53341a)A Wicker Man is an invitation written in dry bundles and bad judgment. Rebuilt from Bloodied Wicker Bundles and burned, it calls the Horned Huntsman.[#]()
pages.title: The Wicker Man

pages.text: [#](53341a)The shape matters — a near miss is only a bonfire.[#]()
[#](53341a)Nine saplings. Witchery saplings — rowan, alder, hawthorn — count too, once grown.[#]()
[#](53341a)Five bundles and one **Demonic Blood** make five bloodied bundles. You need twenty for the figure.[#]()
[#](53341a)Build a flat, human-shaped wall from exactly twenty Bloodied Wicker Bundles: two-wide legs, a four-wide body and arms, then a two-wide head, each row centered above the last.[#]()
pages.title: The Figure

pages.text: [#](53341a)Leave the surrounding cells empty — stray bloodied wicker spoils the match.[#]()
[#](53341a)Then use flint and steel on any bundle to summon the Horned Huntsman at its base.[#]()
